h: Trust and Teshuvah Restore Hope When Holiness Is Tested

p: ה׳ רוֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר וְגוֹ׳ (תְּהִלִּים כג, א)
"Hashem is my shepherd, I shall not lack, etc." (Tehillim 23:1).
David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
was the chariot for the attribute of Malchus
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינַן לָהּ
"the mouth — we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
וְנִקְרָא רַבָּן שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי רוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ
and is called the master of those with ruach hakodesh,
And so it is stated (in Sanhedrin 93b):
that the halachah follows him everywhere."
(פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג צח, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
(this parashah, III 98a, end of the side):
"From the side of the Tree of good and evil,
"'He gave prey to those who fear Him' (Tehillim 111:5):
which is taken from a distant place, etc."
That is: after the mixture of good and evil,
the holy sparks from the kelipah,
"Though I walk in the valley of the shadow of death,
I shall fear no evil, etc.":
"evil" is what blemish of the covenant is called,
as is written in the holy Zohar (there),
and so this pasuk is expounded
And David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
had claims against him about this blemish.
are all the letters of the Torah,
and when they are each composed of ten,
it is the gematria of ער (270);
and there is from the side
of the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil,
and there the yetzer hara can
and this is the gematria of רע (evil).
that it was not from the side of evil
in the manner of what they said,
"'And Hashem is with him' — that the halachah follows him";
from the six days of Creation";
And this is "For You are with me":
that the fear of Hashem Yisbarach never left
and it did not occur to him
that he was committing a sin.
when the Navi said to him,
and he saw that the sin was attributed to him,
and they expounded on this in the Midrash
as it says, 'Of David: Judge me, Hashem.'"
And he said, "For I have walked in my innocence":
that I acted in innocence of heart,
not knowing that it was a sin.
for trust is called a staff,
מִשְׁעֶנֶת קָנֶה רָצוּץ (מְלָכִים ב יח, כא)
"It happened with a certain chassid, etc.:
'Perhaps from the strain of the journey
a nocturnal emission befell my master?'
He said to them: 'By the Temple service,
it is either Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava
and this is from the Gemara (Bava Kamma 103b).
וְלָמָּה לֹא פֵּירֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י כֵּן מִקּוֹדֶם
And why did Rashi not explain so earlier
if, chas v'shalom, this should happen:
for we find this with a certain chassid,
שֶׁהוּא אוֹ רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בָּבָא
who is either Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava
this is the generation of Moshe and Yehoshua;
this is the generation of Chizkiyah;
'a woman who fears Hashem, she shall be praised'
זֶה דּוֹרוֹ שֶׁל רַבִּי יְהוּדָא בֶּן אִלְעַאי כוּ׳
this is the generation of Rabbi Yehudah ben Il'ai, etc."
And nevertheless it is written in the Gemara
And likewise David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
about whom this blemish is written,
that, chas v'shalom, he strayed from the path
for he was the chariot for the attribute of Malchus,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זוֹכֶה לַאֲכִילָה בִּקְדוּשָּׁה
and through this he merits eating in holiness;
for this is the matter of the table of kings
and the crown of the Table
that is, his eating was in holiness,
and on the contrary it is actual "prey,"
like Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him,
whose meal is written in the words of Torah
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה מִמֵּילָא לֹא אֶחְסָר
and through this, automatically, "I shall not lack."
and the fear of Hashem Yisbarach never left
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָאֲרִ״י הַקָּדוֹשׁ זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
and as the holy Arizal, zt"l, wrote,
such a thing to a tzaddik
וְכֵן אָמַר דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And likewise David HaMelech, peace be upon him, said,
בַּה׳ בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אֶמְעָד (תְּהִלִּים כו, א)
"In Hashem I have trusted; I shall not falter" (Tehillim 26:1).
And likewise Shabbos is in the secret of the covenant,
as is written in the holy Zohar
of the days of the Omer count,
which are in order to purify us
And likewise the eating of Shabbos:
on Shabbos at all the meals.
